memory.description: Persistent knowledge graph — durable, cross-session memory of entities, relations and observations. Official @modelcontextprotocol reference server. Needs Node (Tlamatini provisions it automatically).

sequential-thinking.description: Structured step-by-step reasoning with branching and revision. Official @modelcontextprotocol reference server. Needs Node (Tlamatini provisions it automatically).

torrent-search-mcp.description: Torrent Search MCP Server — search for torrents across multiple providers, scrape results using crawl4ai, and cache results with aiocache. Provides a FastAPI server and MCP server interface. Author: philogicae. GitHub: https://github.com/philogicae/torrent-search-mcp

youtube.description: YouTube MCP Server — search YouTube videos without the official API, retrieve transcripts, store video info in a vector database, and perform semantic search over transcripts. Requires a Google API key for embeddings. GitHub: https://github.com/blazzmocompany/Youtube-MCP
